statements.text: AI algorithms trained on skewed, inaccurate, or unrepresentative data magnify human biases, lead to discriminatory outcomes. [...] Dr. Turner Lee, are the steps outlined in the Biden-Harris Administration's EO sufficient to address biases in AI that can lead to discriminatory outcomes?
statements.context: Rep. Pressley delivers remarks and questions a witness at a House Oversight Subcommittee hearing on AI and executive-branch authority.

statements.text: I have no doubt that while AI presents opportunities for progress, it also poses significant risks, from undermining our privacy, to inciting political violence, to spreading disinformation. Congress has been slow to act, forcing the Biden-Harris Administration to take executive action to enforce standards and guardrails. The AI EO does just that, and to suggest that the White House is overstepping, especially when just last week, this Subcommittee heard devastating testimony on AI's infringement on the privacy and civil rights of women and girls. So that overreach characterization is absurd, in my opinion.
statements.context: House subcommittee hearing examining White House AI executive action, framed by the majority as executive overreach.

statements.text: And, Dr. Turner Lee, what elements of the EO can Congress strengthen to ensure that advances in AI technology are not used to further involve people with the criminal legal system?
statements.context: Representative Ayanna Pressley questions a witness during a congressional hearing titled 'White House Overreach on AI.'

statements.text: As a member of the Financial Services Committees' Bipartisan Working Group on Artificial Intelligence, I have no doubt that while AI presents opportunities for progress, it also poses significant risks from undermining our privacy to inciting political violence to spreading disinformation.

statements.text: So I invite all my colleagues to link arms and minds, if you will, in carrying out that work, whether it's the use of facial recognition technology to criminalize people of color, deepfake pornography to degrade women, or biased algorithms to keep vulnerable community members from accessing critical resources.

statements.text: All right. Now, let us talk about why regulating AI matters.
